newsitem.title: USA: Platinum Entertainment Q2 excludes Intersound.
newsitem.headline: Platinum Entertainment Q2 excludes Intersound.

text.p: Platinum Entertainment Inc, reporting a November 30 second-quarter loss of $0.18 a share on lower gross revenues of $7.1 million, said results excluded revenues and earnings related to its previously announced acquisition of Intersound Inc.

"We had hoped to close the acquisition during the second quarter of fiscal 1997, but as a result of due dilligence delays, the closing has been moved to the company's fiscal third quarter," President Steven Devick said in a statement.

On a pro forma basis, Platinum/Intersound results for the fiscal second quarter reflect revenues exceeding $18.8 million generating more than $2.1 million of EBITDA, or EBITDA per share greater than $0.42, Platinum said.
In the year-ago second quarter, Platinum posted earnings of $0.18 per share on gross revenues of $7.2 million.
The company, which had its initial public offering on March 12, 1996, produces, licenses, acquires and markets recorded music in a variety of formats.
